ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, the rectangular conductor wire frame abcd is located on the left side of the magnetic-field boundary MN, and the dashed line MN is a straight-line boundary; on the right side of MN there are crosses, indicating that the uniform magnetic field is perpendicular to the plane of the paper inward. The wire frame enters the magnetic field from outside the magnetic field at a uniform speed along a direction perpendicular to MN. In the figure, ab is a long side of the rectangle, bc is a short side, and the problem gives ab>bc. Let the long side ab=L, the short side bc=W, and L>W; the total resistance of the wire frame is R, the magnetic induction intensity is B, and the magnitude of the speed of entry both times is v. First time: side ab enters the magnetic field parallel to MN. During the entering process, the rate of change of magnetic flux is equal to B multiplied by the rate of change of the entering area; the side length effectively cutting magnetic induction lines is L, so the induced electromotive force ε1=BLv. For the wire frame to completely enter the magnetic field, the distance it needs to advance is W, therefore the time t1=W/v. The generated heat Q1=(ε1^2/R)t1=(B^2L^2v^2/R)(W/v)=B^2L^2Wv/R. Second time: side bc enters the magnetic field parallel to MN. The side length effectively cutting magnetic induction lines is W, so the induced electromotive force ε2=BWv. For the wire frame to completely enter the magnetic field, the distance it needs to advance is L, therefore the time t2=L/v. The generated heat Q2=(ε2^2/R)t2=(B^2W^2v^2/R)(L/v)=B^2W^2Lv/R. Comparison: Q1/Q2=(B^2L^2Wv/R)/(B^2W^2Lv/R)=L/W. Since L>W, Q1/Q2>1, that is, Q1>Q2.

method.method_draft: 设矩形长边 ab=L，短边 bc=W，且 L>W。由图读出磁场边界 MN 是一条直线，线框以相同速度 v 垂直边界进入磁场。第一次 ab 平行 MN，所以切割磁感线的有效边长为 L，进入过程持续的距离为 W，时间 t1=W/v；感应电动势 ε1=BLv，热量 Q1=(ε1^2/R)t1=B^2L^2v^2/R·W/v。第二次 bc 平行 MN，有效切割边长为 W，进入过程持续距离为 L，时间 t2=L/v；ε2=BWv，Q2=(ε2^2/R)t2=B^2W^2v^2/R·L/v。比较得 Q1/Q2=L/W>1，因此 Q1>Q2。
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中矩形导体线框 abcd 位于磁场边界 MN 的左侧，虚线 MN 是一条直线边界；MN 右侧有叉号，表示匀强磁场垂直纸面向里。线框从磁场外沿垂直于 MN 的方向匀速进入磁场。图中 ab 为矩形的一条长边，bc 为短边，且题给 ab>bc。

设长边 ab=L，短边 bc=W，且 L>W；线框总电阻为 R，磁感应强度为 B，两次进入速度大小均为 v。

第一次：ab 边平行 MN 进入磁场。进入过程中，磁通量变化率等于 B 乘以进入面积的变化率，有效切割磁感线的边长为 L，所以感应电动势 ε1=BLv。线框完全进入磁场需要前进的距离为 W，因此时间 t1=W/v。产生的热量 Q1=(ε1^2/R)t1=(B^2L^2v^2/R)(W/v)=B^2L^2Wv/R。

第二次：bc 边平行 MN 进入磁场。有效切割磁感线的边长为 W，所以感应电动势 ε2=BWv。线框完全进入磁场需要前进的距离为 L，因此时间 t2=L/v。产生的热量 Q2=(ε2^2/R)t2=(B^2W^2v^2/R)(L/v)=B^2W^2Lv/R。

比较：Q1/Q2=(B^2L^2Wv/R)/(B^2W^2Lv/R)=L/W。由于 L>W，所以 Q1/Q2>1，即 Q1>Q2。

method.method_draft: 利用总磁通量变化和进入时间比较。两次线框完全进入同一匀强磁场，初始磁通量均为 0，最终磁通量均为 B·S，其中 S=ab·bc，所以两次总磁通量变化量相同。由 ∫εdt=ΔΦ 可知两次通过导体横截面的总电荷量 q=∫Idt=ΔΦ/R 相同。进入过程中感应电流恒定：第一次进入时需要移动短边距离 bc，时间 t1=bc/v；第二次进入时需要移动长边距离 ab，时间 t2=ab/v。因 ab>bc，所以 t2>t1。相同总电荷量在较短时间内通过时电流更大，且 Q=I^2Rt=q^2R/t，因此 Q1>Q2。

raw_record.original_question: 纸面内有一矩形导体闭合线框 abcd，ab 边长大于 bc 边长，置于垂直纸面向里、边界为 MN 的匀强磁场外。线框两次匀速地完全进入磁场，两次速度大小相同，方向均垂直于 MN。第一次 ab 边平行 MN 进入磁场，线框上产生的热量为 Q1；第二次 bc 边平行 MN 进入磁场，线框上产生的热量为 Q2。比较 Q1 与 Q2 的大小关系。
raw_record.final_cot:
First describe the image: In the figure, the rectangular conductor wire frame abcd is located on the left side of the magnetic-field boundary MN, and the dashed line MN is a straight-line boundary; on the right side of MN there are crosses, indicating that the uniform magnetic field is perpendicular to the plane of the paper inward. The wire frame enters the magnetic field from outside the magnetic field at a uniform speed along a direction perpendicular to MN. In the figure, ab is a long side of the rectangle, bc is a short side, and the problem gives ab>bc.

Let the long side ab=L, the short side bc=W, and L>W; the total resistance of the wire frame is R, the magnetic induction intensity is B, and the magnitude of the speed of entry both times is v.

First time: side ab enters the magnetic field parallel to MN. During the entering process, the rate of change of magnetic flux is equal to B multiplied by the rate of change of the entering area; the side length effectively cutting magnetic induction lines is L, so the induced electromotive force ε1=BLv. For the wire frame to completely enter the magnetic field, the distance it needs to advance is W, therefore the time t1=W/v. The generated heat Q1=(ε1^2/R)t1=(B^2L^2v^2/R)(W/v)=B^2L^2Wv/R.

Second time: side bc enters the magnetic field parallel to MN. The side length effectively cutting magnetic induction lines is W, so the induced electromotive force ε2=BWv. For the wire frame to completely enter the magnetic field, the distance it needs to advance is L, therefore the time t2=L/v. The generated heat Q2=(ε2^2/R)t2=(B^2W^2v^2/R)(L/v)=B^2W^2Lv/R.

Comparison: Q1/Q2=(B^2L^2Wv/R)/(B^2W^2Lv/R)=L/W. Since L>W, Q1/Q2>1, that is, Q1>Q2.
